piece: Galeotto Fibindacci da Ricasoli to the Signoria of Florence, Urbino, no. 171
shelfmark: ASF, Dieci di Balìa, Responsive 2 no. 171 (old 168) (DECODE R3754)
system: Homophonic substitution of graphic signs (two or three per letter) with about 17 nulls and a nomenclator of about 30 signs (persons, places, 'che', 'per', 'con'); about twenty short runs inside clear Italian. Key: Gabbrielli 1863 (Meister 1902) extended here from sibling glosses.
outcome: read (98.0% of cipher tokens given a value)
sign_inventory_note: Sign names of cipher171.tsv (as in key_extended.md: Unicode look-alikes such as ∵, ᴗ, ⊐, ∂, ℘, +o). 0: = value 'null' in the TSV; N: = a sign whose value is a word or name (il Conte, Dieci, fanti, il Papa, ella ...). Each TSV run (L2a, L3b ...) is one line. The cipher writes no word separators.
plaintext: pavolo dimadonn cintadini il conte il papa acomandino alo madonna pure femina e sospetosa conte d urbino fanti dieci madonna parenti citadini ella il conte
plaintext_source: value column of cipher171.tsv (letters joined per run; word/name values as words)
